title: 第169章 原来如此第168章 有良心
content_zh:
沈二觉得他没心没肺，安衍却来了兴致，分析道：
“宗门向来以左为尊，姬伯以是右护法，姬仲颜是左护法，到底谁更厉害……”
安衍故意卖了个关子，让他们自己猜。
“我觉得姬仲颜更强。”沈二插嘴道，“他是我在这世上遇到的最厉害的人，烤的鱼还特别好吃。”
回想起那烤鱼的滋味，沈二口中开始分泌口涎。
百里识越鄙夷地看她一眼，“一顿吃的就把你收买了，没出息。”
沈二：“你懂个蛋。”
“切～”
姬伯以站在雨中，头顶是重新生成的叶片屏障，但还是有不少雨水落在他肩上，发上，顺着他的发尾往下滴。
“你什么时候见钱眼开上了？我怎么不知道？”姬伯以问。
黑影：“……”
“行行行，我知道你接到的任务是拖住王铭钟等我过来，人也已经弄死了。”
“但你不觉得这样很亏吗？他灭了我们三个暗桩，害死几十号兄弟姐妹，挖眼掏心放血抽骨，我没把他碎尸万段算轻的。”
黑影：“……”
姬伯以脸色瞬间缓和，“好，我等会把他再鞭尸一遍。”
“……”
司徒仁宏：“姬伯以，你欺人太甚！”
沈二瞄他一眼，“他确实该死，你人活下来就不错了，别再叫唤。”
百里识越：“对待妖物本该如此。”
此话一出，好几道视线朝他投过来，其中有道吃人的最是明显，百里识越话锋一转，“当然，只是对极个别十恶不赦的妖物，大多数的妖，妖品还是不错的。”

姬伯以冷哼，姑且不跟他计较。
“漂亮姐姐刚刚是在跟谁说话？”韩三宝满脑子的问号，挠挠头，自言自语，“是那个鬼吗？可是那个鬼好像没有说话啊。”
“三宝。”
这两个字有两个人同时说出口，一个是韩执旭，另一个是笑眯眯的姬伯以。
韩执旭心中警铃大作，手紧紧抓住韩三宝的小臂。
姬伯以朝韩三宝勾勾手指，“你过来，我给你拿好吃的。”
好吃的！
韩三宝蠢蠢欲动。
“不要去。”韩执旭表情严肃，韩三宝极少看到这样的韩执旭，吓得在原地愣了下，迟迟不敢动作。
“师兄……”韩三宝低低唤道。
韩执旭神色松缓些许，“三宝听话，记不记得师父怎么教你的？见到陌生人要怎么样？”
韩三宝眼珠子滴溜一转，乖乖回答：“要讲理，要客气。”
“还有呢？”
“要警惕，陌生人给的东西不能要，特别是吃食。”韩三宝话声越来越低，看着自己怀里已经少了一半的果子，又解释道：
“这些都是三宝自己从树上摘的，不是漂亮姐姐给的。”
韩执旭不说话，静静地看着他。
韩三宝低下头，念念叨叨：“三宝知道了，三宝听师兄话，三宝不过去。”
“好三宝。”韩执旭拍拍他的肩膀。
姬伯以看着这一幕，倒也没气恼，自讨没趣的收回视线，余光往边上一扫，厉声道：“魅妩，滚出来。”
不远处，阴暗的树丛发出轻颤，最先看见的，是一条白得发亮的腿。
content_en:
Shen Er thought he was heartless, but An Yan became interested and analyzed:
"The sect has always respected the left, Ji Bo is the right protector, and Ji Zhongyan is the left protector. Who is more powerful..."
Anyan deliberately kept it secret and let them guess.
"I think Ji Zhongyan is stronger." Shen Er interrupted, "He is the most powerful person I have ever met in this world, and the grilled fish is particularly delicious."
Recalling the taste of the grilled fish, Shen Er began to salivate.
Baili Shiyue looked at her with disdain, "I bribed you with just one meal. You have no future."
Shen Er: "You know nothing."
"Cut~"
Ji Boyi stood in the rain, with a regenerated leaf barrier above his head, but there was still a lot of rain falling on his shoulders, on his hair, and dripping down the ends of his hair.
"When did you become obsessed with money? Why didn't I know?" Ji Boyi asked.
Black Shadow: "..."
"Okay, okay, I know your mission is to hold Wang Mingzhong until I come over, and he has already been killed."
"But don't you think it's a shame? He killed three of us, killed dozens of brothers and sisters, gouged out his eyes, drained his heart, bled out his bones, and I didn't break him into pieces. It's not a big deal."
Black Shadow: "..."
Ji Bo's expression instantly softened, "Okay, I'll beat him to death again later."
"..."
Situ Renhong: "Ji Boyi, you are going too far!"
Shen Er glanced at him and said, "He really deserves to die. It's good for you to survive. Stop yelling."
Baili Shiyue: "This is how you should treat monsters."
As soon as he said this, several eyes were cast towards him, among which one was the most obvious one who was a cannibal. Baili Shiyue changed the subject, "Of course, it's only for a few heinous monsters. Most monsters are pretty good."
Uncle Ji snorted coldly, let's not argue with him for now.
"Who was the pretty sister talking to just now?" Han Sanbao's mind was full of questions, he scratched his head and said to himself, "Is it that ghost? But the ghost doesn't seem to be talking."
"Three Treasures."
Two people said these two words at the same time, one was Han Zhixu, and the other was the smiling Ji Boyi.
Warning bells rang in Han Zhixu's heart, and he tightly grasped Han Sanbao's forearm.
Uncle Ji hooked his fingers with the three treasures of Korea and Korea, "Come here, I will get you something delicious."
Delicious!
Han Sanbao is ready to make a move.
"Don't go." Han Zhixu's expression was serious. Han Sanbao rarely saw Han Zhixu like this. He was so frightened that he froze on the spot and did not dare to move.
"Senior brother..." Han Sanbao called in a low voice.
Han Zhixu looked a little more relaxed, "Sambo, be obedient. Do you remember what Master taught you? What should you do when you meet a stranger?"
Han Sanbao rolled his eyes and replied obediently: "Be reasonable and polite."
"What else?"
"Be careful. Don't ask for things from strangers, especially food." Han Sanbao's voice became lower and lower, and he looked at the fruit in his arms that was already half missing, and explained:
"Sambo picked these from the trees himself, not from my beautiful sister."
Han Zhixu said nothing and looked at him quietly.
Han Sanbao lowered his head and muttered: "Sanbao knows, Sanbao listens to senior brother, Sanbao cannot pass."
"Good Sambo." Han Zhixu patted him on the shoulder.
Ji Boyi looked at this scene, but he was not angry at all. He looked away in annoyance, glanced to the side with his peripheral vision, and said sternly: "Mei Wu, get out."
Not far away, the dark trees trembled slightly, and the first thing I saw was a shining white leg.
